input: Qin et al. (2024) note that APIs on RapidAPI change over time, and in the main ToolBench table every method except ToolLLaMA-DFSDT-Retriever uses the oracle API retriever (ground-truth APIs). DFSDT also explores more solution paths than ReACT. Critique a claim that the main results reflect real-world use where the model must find APIs among 16,000+ by itself.
source: Qin et al. 2024, Section 3 Experiments, Table 4 (chunks qin2024-017, qin2024-020, qin2024-022)
